title: James O. Mason
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married L. Marie Smith 1952, Salt Lake Temple; seven children
Director, US Public Health Service, 1989-1993 under President George H.W. Bush
President of the Bountiful Utah Temple 2000-2003.
